Every message is the legacy wording of RWB-E1-007, except MSG-P1-001, whose English text is copied from Error and Message Standard v4 (CG-ALL-153), and is asserted unchanged in the run; the run adds no message of its own and its report text is for the release team only.

Error and Message Standard v4 §4 uses MSG-P4-001 for 'Sign-in with no Workbench role' and MSG-P4-003 for 'A record outside the role's scope'. This story uses them for a call without a session and a resend that names an unknown item. The standard's message IDs for these two uses are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-156); the rows above keep the legacy wording until the standard allocates them.
